decision_paths.description: Work is blocked until the blocker is removed and the blocked step can resume normally.
A temporary bounded path exists, but the blocker remains reviewable and must still be tracked.
The operator is deliberately proceeding with known exposure that remains documented and reviewable.
The blocked step will not proceed now and must carry explicit follow-up ownership and review timing.

trigger_definitions.description: The exact next committed ART step cannot proceed without another event, permission, fix, or decision.
A live broker or OpenProject mutation, closeout, or review action failed and the same proof cycle did not clear it.
The same active ART step failed again after an earlier corrective attempt in the same task or session.
A required principal, approval, PI commitment, iteration, runtime, or environment prerequisite is missing for committed work.
An unresolved dependency or external owner dependency prevents the next committed step from proceeding.
Security, trust-boundary, or governance review is explicitly holding the active step.
A quality gate or readiness gate prevents the active transition, closeout, or review step.

recording_rules.description: Once the blocker is known, record it before continuing adjacent ART mutation on the same initiative.
When the blocker is caused by a live system or workflow control bug, open or update a real Defect in ART instead of leaving the issue only in chat or a candidate.
When the blocker creates exposure broader than one blocked work item, represent that exposure as a Risk with ROAM fields.

transition_rules.description: Generic create, update, and planning-repair surfaces do not set or clear blocked status; use the dedicated blocker workflow.
A blocked work item must carry the bounded blocker fields, including follow-up owner and review date when the decision path is not remove.
Active blocker fields must not remain on an item whose status is no longer blocked.
Clearing a blocker must resume to new, ready, or in-progress. Use parking, retirement, or completion workflows for other terminal outcomes.
